name: us1-adopt-privacy-block
description: 003 US1 (T049): the BLOCK-tier privacy guard applies to adoption with NO exemption. Adoption's only payload field it controls is the marker's repository identifier; here it carries a real Cloud host, which is a BLOCK-tier coordinate. Because the stamp set goes through the shared write path, the guard runs BEFORE the first write: exit 9 and zero property PUTs in the call log (FR-028, FR-030, Principle IX).
